state.robot: iRobot Create 3: a round 34 cm floor robot that can drive forward, back up, and turn in place.
state.task: Follow waypoints along a route planned around known walls, without colliding. Obstacle sensors only see about 20 cm ahead of the bumper.

action.instructions: Choose the robot's motion for the next half second. Head for the next waypoint and never drive toward an obstacle that a sensor reports as near or very close.

criteria.forward: Drive straight at full speed: waypoint straight ahead and front sensors clear.
criteria.creep: Drive straight slowly: waypoint ahead but something far in front.
criteria.veer_left: Curve forward to the left: waypoint ahead-left, or obstacle on the right.
criteria.veer_right: Curve forward to the right: waypoint ahead-right, or obstacle on the left.
criteria.turn_left: Spin in place to the left: waypoint left or behind, or front blocked and left more open.
criteria.turn_right: Spin in place to the right: waypoint right or behind, or front blocked and right more open.
criteria.back_up: Reverse slowly: only when the bumper is pressed or the front is very close.

detour_side.instructions: Does an obstacle stand between the robot and the waypoint, and if so, which side should the robot go around it on? The robot keeps this plan for the next few seconds.

criteria.none: Nothing blocks the way toward the waypoint.
criteria.left: Go around the obstacle on the left side; the left sensors are more open.
criteria.right: Go around the obstacle on the right side; the right sensors are more open.

action.instructions: Choose the robot's motion for the next half second. Head for the next waypoint and never drive toward an obstacle that a sensor reports as near or very close.

criteria.forward: Drive straight at full speed: waypoint straight ahead and front sensors clear.
criteria.creep: Drive straight slowly: waypoint ahead but something far in front.
criteria.veer_left: Curve forward to the left: waypoint ahead-left, or obstacle on the right.
criteria.veer_right: Curve forward to the right: waypoint ahead-right, or obstacle on the left.
criteria.turn_left: Spin in place to the left: waypoint left or behind, or front blocked and left more open.
criteria.turn_right: Spin in place to the right: waypoint right or behind, or front blocked and right more open.
criteria.back_up: Reverse slowly: only when the bumper is pressed or the front is very close.

detour_side.instructions: Does an obstacle stand between the robot and the waypoint, and if so, which side should the robot go around it on? The robot keeps this plan for the next few seconds.

criteria.none: Nothing blocks the way toward the waypoint.
criteria.left: Go around the obstacle on the left side; the left sensors are more open.
criteria.right: Go around the obstacle on the right side; the right sensors are more open.

criteria.forward: Drive straight at full speed: waypoint straight ahead and front sensors clear.
criteria.creep: Drive straight slowly: waypoint ahead but something far in front.
criteria.veer_left: Curve forward to the left: waypoint ahead-left, or obstacle on the right.
criteria.veer_right: Curve forward to the right: waypoint ahead-right, or obstacle on the left.
criteria.turn_left: Spin in place to the left: waypoint left or behind, or front blocked and left more open.
criteria.turn_right: Spin in place to the right: waypoint right or behind, or front blocked and right more open.
criteria.back_up: Reverse slowly: only when the bumper is pressed or the front is very close.

detour_side.instructions: Does an obstacle stand between the robot and the waypoint, and if so, which side should the robot go around it on? The robot keeps this plan for the next few seconds.

criteria.none: Nothing blocks the way toward the waypoint.
criteria.left: Go around the obstacle on the left side; the left sensors are more open.
criteria.right: Go around the obstacle on the right side; the right sensors are more open.

criteria.forward: Drive straight at full speed: waypoint straight ahead and front sensors clear.
criteria.creep: Drive straight slowly: waypoint ahead but something far in front.
criteria.veer_left: Curve forward to the left: waypoint ahead-left, or obstacle on the right.
criteria.veer_right: Curve forward to the right: waypoint ahead-right, or obstacle on the left.
criteria.turn_left: Spin in place to the left: waypoint left or behind, or front blocked and left more open.
criteria.turn_right: Spin in place to the right: waypoint right or behind, or front blocked and right more open.
criteria.back_up: Reverse slowly: only when the bumper is pressed or the front is very close.

detour_side.instructions: Does an obstacle stand between the robot and the waypoint, and if so, which side should the robot go around it on? The robot keeps this plan for the next few seconds.

criteria.none: Nothing blocks the way toward the waypoint.
criteria.left: Go around the obstacle on the left side; the left sensors are more open.
criteria.right: Go around the obstacle on the right side; the right sensors are more open.

criteria.forward: Drive straight at full speed: waypoint straight ahead and front sensors clear.
criteria.creep: Drive straight slowly: waypoint ahead but something far in front.
criteria.veer_left: Curve forward to the left: waypoint ahead-left, or obstacle on the right.
criteria.veer_right: Curve forward to the right: waypoint ahead-right, or obstacle on the left.
criteria.turn_left: Spin in place to the left: waypoint left or behind, or front blocked and left more open.
criteria.turn_right: Spin in place to the right: waypoint right or behind, or front blocked and right more open.
criteria.back_up: Reverse slowly: only when the bumper is pressed or the front is very close.

detour_side.instructions: Does an obstacle stand between the robot and the waypoint, and if so, which side should the robot go around it on? The robot keeps this plan for the next few seconds.

criteria.none: Nothing blocks the way toward the waypoint.
criteria.left: Go around the obstacle on the left side; the left sensors are more open.
criteria.right: Go around the obstacle on the right side; the right sensors are more open.

criteria.forward: Drive straight at full speed: waypoint straight ahead and front sensors clear.
criteria.creep: Drive straight slowly: waypoint ahead but something far in front.

criteria.turn_left: Spin in place to the left: waypoint left or behind, or front blocked and left more open.

detour_side.instructions: Does an obstacle stand between the robot and the waypoint, and if so, which side should the robot go around it on? The robot keeps this plan for the next few seconds.

criteria.right: Go around the obstacle on the right side; the right sensors are more open.

action.instructions: Choose the robot's motion for the next half second. Head for the next waypoint and never drive toward an obstacle that a sensor reports as near or very close.

criteria.forward: Drive straight at full speed: waypoint straight ahead and front sensors clear.
criteria.creep: Drive straight slowly: waypoint ahead but something far in front.
criteria.veer_left: Curve forward to the left: waypoint ahead-left, or obstacle on the right.
criteria.veer_right: Curve forward to the right: waypoint ahead-right, or obstacle on the left.
criteria.turn_left: Spin in place to the left: waypoint left or behind, or front blocked and left more open.
criteria.turn_right: Spin in place to the right: waypoint right or behind, or front blocked and right more open.
criteria.back_up: Reverse slowly: only when the bumper is pressed or the front is very close.

detour_side.instructions: Does an obstacle stand between the robot and the waypoint, and if so, which side should the robot go around it on? The robot keeps this plan for the next few seconds.

criteria.none: Nothing blocks the way toward the waypoint.
criteria.left: Go around the obstacle on the left side; the left sensors are more open.
criteria.right: Go around the obstacle on the right side; the right sensors are more open.

criteria.forward: Drive straight at full speed: waypoint straight ahead and front sensors clear.
criteria.creep: Drive straight slowly: waypoint ahead but something far in front.

criteria.veer_right: Curve forward to the right: waypoint ahead-right, or obstacle on the left.
criteria.turn_left: Spin in place to the left: waypoint left or behind, or front blocked and left more open.
criteria.turn_right: Spin in place to the right: waypoint right or behind, or front blocked and right more open.
criteria.back_up: Reverse slowly: only when the bumper is pressed or the front is very close.

detour_side.instructions: Does an obstacle stand between the robot and the waypoint, and if so, which side should the robot go around it on? The robot keeps this plan for the next few seconds.

criteria.none: Nothing blocks the way toward the waypoint.

criteria.right: Go around the obstacle on the right side; the right sensors are more open.

action.instructions: Choose the robot's motion for the next half second. Head for the next waypoint and never drive toward an obstacle that a sensor reports as near or very close.

criteria.forward: Drive straight at full speed: waypoint straight ahead and front sensors clear.
criteria.creep: Drive straight slowly: waypoint ahead but something far in front.
criteria.veer_left: Curve forward to the left: waypoint ahead-left, or obstacle on the right.
criteria.veer_right: Curve forward to the right: waypoint ahead-right, or obstacle on the left.
criteria.turn_left: Spin in place to the left: waypoint left or behind, or front blocked and left more open.
criteria.turn_right: Spin in place to the right: waypoint right or behind, or front blocked and right more open.
criteria.back_up: Reverse slowly: only when the bumper is pressed or the front is very close.

detour_side.instructions: Does an obstacle stand between the robot and the waypoint, and if so, which side should the robot go around it on? The robot keeps this plan for the next few seconds.

criteria.none: Nothing blocks the way toward the waypoint.
criteria.left: Go around the obstacle on the left side; the left sensors are more open.
criteria.right: Go around the obstacle on the right side; the right sensors are more open.

criteria.forward: Drive straight at full speed: waypoint straight ahead and front sensors clear.
criteria.creep: Drive straight slowly: waypoint ahead but something far in front.

criteria.veer_right: Curve forward to the right: waypoint ahead-right, or obstacle on the left.
criteria.turn_left: Spin in place to the left: waypoint left or behind, or front blocked and left more open.

criteria.back_up: Reverse slowly: only when the bumper is pressed or the front is very close.

criteria.right: Go around the obstacle on the right side; the right sensors are more open.

action.instructions: Choose the robot's motion for the next half second. Head for the next waypoint and never drive toward an obstacle that a sensor reports as near or very close.

criteria.creep: Drive straight slowly: waypoint ahead but something far in front.

criteria.turn_left: Spin in place to the left: waypoint left or behind, or front blocked and left more open.

action.instructions: Choose the robot's motion for the next half second. Head for the next waypoint and never drive toward an obstacle that a sensor reports as near or very close.
